product_description:
Philips Heartstart MRx Monitor/Defibrillator
Models: M3535A (Hospital Use) , M3536A (EMS Use)
reason_for_recall: In Software versions below A.02.00, with the sync function enabled and the device switched from manual to AED, there may be an unexpected delay in delivery of energy
action: Philips notified customers on 12/13/04 by letter. Users are provided with action required to Mitigate Risk' until the correction is made by a Systems representative.
